children.text: The live team board needs the DSH Go local engine bridge. This static view is what renders without it.

items.title: Board
items.subtitle: Every task of the active team with its owner and status; tap a row to open it.

items.title: Members
items.subtitle: Who is on this team, their mode and their handoff state.

items.title: Detail
items.subtitle: The selected task's owner, dependencies, verdict and its settle buttons.

items.title: Watchdog
items.subtitle: The predicate in force, the preserving hold and the last incidents.

children.text: Boards are served by the local engine only, so a relay or SSH host shows tool cards instead of this panel.
